critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx still uses lowercase fetchpriority='high' on hero (line 54) — React logs warning about invalid DOM prop. Cosmetic — rename to fetchPriority (camelCase) to silence warning.

Services.jsx line 14 fallback document.title still uses the old string 'Practice — Renovations, Extensions & New Builds · Apollo Builders'. The word 'Practice' is one of the removed audit terms; while not visible in the DOM, it appears in the browser tab when landing on /services (no slug). Consider changing to 'Our services — Melbourne South-East · Apollo Builders' to fully align with the design-audit copy rules.

Scene3D imported/lazy-loaded elsewhere is no longer used on Home hero — verify no orphaned import in components tree (Scene3D.jsx still exists in /components); safe to delete file if truly unused to reduce bundle size.
BlueprintProcess uses gsap ScrollTrigger + Lenis smooth scroll — functional but ensure ScrollTrigger.refresh() called after Lenis init if any future scroll-jank bug appears.
brand.logo, hero image, project images and About/Contact hero photos all hotlink from apollobuilders.com.au CDN — consider self-hosting to remove third-party dependency and improve LCP.
